title: Exopolysaccharides and conjugated linoleic acids produced by selected lactic acid bacteria: physicochemical attributes, antimicrobial activity, and techno-functional properties of exopolysaccharides

Lactobacillus acidophilus LDMB01 and Enterococcus faecium D325 produced 2.21 and 1.63 g L−1 EPS. Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus M240 and Lactobacillus acidophilus LDMB01 showed strong CLA production, and antimicrobial EPS activity.
